About Nibbly

Nibbly is a puzzle game for children and adults. There are no advertisements, chat, public profiles, or account registration. A grown-up should manage purchases and contact support.

Progress and custom levels

Progress, settings, replays and custom puzzles are stored on your device. We do not upload them to a game server. Android and iOS may include app data in device backups according to your system settings. You can export or import campaign progress and custom puzzles using files you choose. Exported files and copies shared through another app are handled according to where you store or share them; that app's privacy practices may apply.

Optional purchases

The first 20 levels can be played without enabling purchase services. A grown-up check appears before purchase options, restoration or support email. Enabling purchase options allows the App Store on iPhone or Google Play on Android, together with RevenueCat, to process purchase history and check purchase access on subsequent launches on this device.

The App Store or Google Play processes payments. Nibbly does not receive payment-card details. RevenueCat processes a randomly generated app-user identifier, purchase receipts or tokens, product and transaction identifiers, purchase history and status, dates, prices, currency and entitlement information. It also processes platform, operating-system version, device model, app and SDK versions, package identifier, preferred locale and storefront country. These data support purchase verification, restoration, fraud prevention and purchase analytics such as sales and revenue reporting.

RevenueCat receives IP addresses through network requests and may use them to estimate a country. RevenueCat states that raw IP addresses are not retained on the customer profile. On iPhone, Apple's identifier for vendors (IDFV) may be transmitted for receipt validation and appear in operational logs. We do not supply a player's name, email address, birthday, age signals, advertising identifier or contacts to RevenueCat. Optional SDK diagnostics and automatic attribution-identifier collection are disabled.

There are no advertising or attribution integrations. Purchase records are retained as needed to maintain access, support restoration, prevent fraud and meet applicable recordkeeping requirements. RevenueCat processes customer-deletion requests asynchronously. After completion, the customer record is removed from its production service systems. Residual logs and backups are normally deleted or overwritten within 90 days, although other internal systems can follow different timelines and records may be retained for legal obligations or claims. RevenueCat states that residual copies are not used and that deletion is reapplied if a backup is restored. Continued purchase-service requests can create a new customer record after deletion.

The App Store, Google Play and RevenueCat maintain their service records under their own policies: Apple App Store & Privacy, Google Privacy Policy and RevenueCat Privacy Policy. A parent or player can contact tidhar.peer@gmail.com to request access to or deletion of purchase-service records. We may need enough information to locate and verify the relevant record. Data sent through any separately enabled third-party integration would need deletion in that system as well.

Children and grown-ups

Children can play without providing a name, email address or birthday. Parents or guardians should manage purchases and email. The grown-up check is an interaction safeguard, not identity verification. Parents should review the purchase-service information before enabling it. Please do not send children's personal information in support messages.

Google Play age requirements

On Android, Nibbly checks with Google Play whether mandatory age sharing applies to the current account. Where it applies, the game requests the available age signals and checks whether age verification or parental approval needs attention. The Settings screen shows the result and lets a grown-up open Google Play or check again.

The age response is processed temporarily on your device. Nibbly does not save age ranges or supervised-install identifiers, include them in progress backups or support drafts, or send them to RevenueCat or an analytics service. The same family safeguards apply to all age groups. Google handles account age verification and supervision under its own privacy practices.

Contacting support

Contact us opens an editable email draft. It includes the game version, platform, build and selected level, plus an optional name field. Nothing is sent automatically. If you send it, we receive your sender address and the details you include, and use them to respond. Messages are retained only as needed for support and applicable recordkeeping.

Requesting purchase-data deletion

On Android, Settings offers a grown-up-protected Request data deletion flow. Preparing the request reads the existing RevenueCat customer ID, stores that ID locally for the request, turns off future purchase-service activation and closes the purchase SDK. Progress and settings stay on the device. The purchase customer ID is excluded from progress-backup exports.

The flow opens an editable email draft addressed to support, including the purchase customer ID, game version and platform. You decide whether to send it. Use a parent or guardian's email address for a child's request. We verify the request and process the relevant RevenueCat deletion manually, then reply. Preparing a draft alone does not delete records.

Keep purchase services off while the request is processed. We may need to coordinate other devices or integrations associated with the same purchase. Full Adventure access checks require purchase services. Enabling them again or restoring purchases can create a new RevenueCat record. The locally saved request identifier is removed when purchase services are explicitly re-enabled. Contact support for help locating records if no identifier is available on the device.

On iPhone, or if the Android flow is unavailable, email tidhar.peer@gmail.com to request deletion of purchase-service records. Include enough information to help us locate the relevant record, but do not send payment-card details.

Your choices

To remove local game data, clear Nibbly's app storage in Android settings or delete the app from your iPhone. Files you exported and copies in device backups may need to be removed separately. Purchase access can be restored with the same App Store or Google Play account that bought it. For privacy questions, access or deletion requests, a parent or player can contact tidhar.peer@gmail.com. Do not include payment-card information. Refund requests are handled through the store where the purchase was made. Personal data is not sold or used for targeted advertising.

Policy updates

This policy will be updated when the game's data practices change. The date above identifies this version.
